# Managed analysis fixture

This source builds the small, unsigned APK in
`src/test/resources/apks/managed-analysis.apk`. Its `onCreate` method calls a
configured source and passes the returned value to a configured sink. It requires
no device and is never installed or executed by the tests. The fixture is covered
by this repository's license.

Run the real-backend integration tests from the repository root:

```sh
mvn -Dtest=AndroidAnalysisApkTest \
    -Dandrospecter.androidPlatforms=/absolute/path/to/android-sdk/platforms test
```

These tests are skipped when the property is absent, so the regular unit-test
suite does not require the Android SDK. Use a platform matching the manifest
target (API 30) for comparable results. Assertions check expected behavior and
specific relationships, rather than global backend-dependent graph counts.

To rebuild the checked-in fixture with Java 17 and Android build-tools 34.0.0:

```sh
bash src/test/fixtures/managed-analysis/build.sh \
    /absolute/path/to/android-sdk 34.0.0 android-30
```

Other compatible build-tools can be supplied explicitly. Rebuilding may change
ZIP timestamps and tool-generated bytes; byte-identical output is not required.
Keep the source and the checked-in APK together when changing fixture behavior.
